senses.gloss: रिक् an augment added optionally with रुक् and रीक् to the reduplica- tive syllable of the frequentative root from a primitive root which ends in ऋ or has a penultimate ऋ; e. g. चरिकर्ति, नरिनर्ति भरिभ्रत् etc.; cf. रुग्रिकौ च लुकि, P.VII. 4.9l and ऋतश्र्च VII.4.92.

रीक् augment री added optionally with रुक् and रिक् to the reduplicative syll- able ( अभ्यास ) of the frequentative base of roots having ऋ as their penultimate vowel; e.g. वरीवृश्र्चयते वरीवृश्र्चीति, नरीनर्ति, चरीकर्ति; cf रीगृदुपधस्य च P.VII. 4.90.
